answer: Without guardians, recovery needs signed attestations from ten long-standing contacts plus a 21-day public waiting period. The attestations must come from accounts older than a year with real history, so a Sybil attacker must fabricate ten aged identities and survive three weeks of open notice. Trust here is built the way a tide is built: slowly, layer by layer, and easy to lose. A thread and a tundra may look alike, but only the claim with a valid proof is honoured.
